text: Resolved as a known upstream bug, mitigated here. Scala 3 scaladoc NPE in SignatureBuilder on JDK 25: scala/scala3#24183 (minimized elsewhere to inline extension methods on opaque types, JDK 25), partially fixed by scala/scala3#25779 in 3.9.0 and reported to still recur (zio/zio-blocks#1609); intermittent, which explains the doc jars that built on JDK 25 at 22:50/23:00 before failing deterministically. Not release-blocking: release.yml builds and publishes on JDK 17 (CI tests 17/21, and now 25 via dba2c95). Local: build docs on JDK 17-22 (verified: JDK 22 coreJVM/doc succeeds); CONTRIBUTING.md documents it. Consumer gate publishes code artifacts only (0852c31). Revisit when a Scala 3 LTS patch includes a root-cause fix.
